title: Style, loop and ordering rules
summary: Eleven style and loop lint rules (begin/end, if-chains, SetLength and repaint in loops, loop bounds, method order); five are on by default
intro: Read this when you want lint to flag loop and layout habits that cost time or hide bugs. Run `drag-lint lint <unit.pas>` or `lint-all`; the style rules (missing-begin-end, redundant-begin-end, prefer-case, string-if-chain, method-order, processmessages-in-handler) are off by default and are switched on with `--rule <id>` or the enabled list of the lint config. boolean-assign-if has a safe autofix.
